method: Point placed 110 m upstream of geometry:fermilab-bnb-target's downstream bearing continuation, i.e. at the sourced 110 m SBND baseline (src:sbnd-detector-paper-2025) along the derived BNB axis. Two OSM building footprints sit near this ideal point but neither is confidently identified as SBND specifically: way 1423112777 (span ~34 m, 17.2 m from the ideal point) and way 1423112778 (span ~10 m, 17.7 m from the ideal point) -- almost equally good positional matches, no OSM tag names either, and no source fetched this session distinguishes them. `feature_type` is `target_station` (a labelled point) rather than the real building footprint because the specific footprint is not confidently identified; drawing either candidate polygon as 'SBND' would overstate certainty.
